# linear_integrations_settings (Resource)

Manages which events a Linear integration posts — the notification matrix behind an already-connected Slack or Microsoft Teams integration.

Connecting the integration itself is an OAuth flow and not something a provider can manage declaratively; this resource configures what an existing connection does. Attach it to exactly one of a team, project, initiative or custom view — all four are fixed at creation, since Linear's update mutation takes only the toggles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connecting Slack is an OAuth flow and not manageable declaratively; this is
# the layer above it — which events an existing connection posts.
resource "linear_integrations_settings" "engineering" {
  team_id = linear_team.engineering.id

  slack_issue_created             = true
  slack_issue_added_to_triage     = true
  slack_issue_status_changed_done = true
  slack_issue_sla_breached        = true
  slack_issue_new_comment         = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `context_view_type` (String) Which surface the settings apply to when attached to a project or initiative, e.g. `project` or `initiative`.
- `custom_view_id` (String) UUID of the `linear_custom_view` these settings belong to. **Write-only**: Linear does not report which view the settings belong to, so drift in this attribute cannot be detected.
- `initiative_id` (String) UUID of the initiative these settings belong to.
- `microsoft_teams_project_update_created` (Boolean) Post to Microsoft Teams when a project update is written.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project these settings belong to.
- `slack_initiative_update_created` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an initiative update is written.
- `slack_issue_added_to_triage` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an issue lands in triage.
- `slack_issue_added_to_view` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an issue enters the attached view.
- `slack_issue_created` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an issue is created.
- `slack_issue_new_comment` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an issue gets a comment.
- `slack_issue_sla_breached` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an issue breaches its SLA.
- `slack_issue_sla_high_risk` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an issue is at risk of breaching its SLA.
- `slack_issue_status_changed_all` (Boolean) Post to Slack on every issue status change.
- `slack_issue_status_changed_done` (Boolean) Post to Slack when an issue is completed. Redundant when `slack_issue_status_changed_all` is on.
- `slack_project_update_created` (Boolean) Post to Slack when a project update is written.
- `slack_project_update_created_to_team` (Boolean) Post project updates to the team's Slack channel.
- `slack_project_update_created_to_workspace` (Boolean) Post project updates to the workspace Slack channel.
- `team_id` (String) UUID of the team these settings belong to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the integrations settings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import linear_integrations_settings.example a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
